5481.title: Background-task state across provider identity replacement
5481.rootCauseOneLine: Identity-event ingestion leaves earlier session task records open until an explicit terminal task event; why the historical edit bypassed its activity guard is unverified.
5481.proposedFix: First reproduce real desktop edit admission and confirmed old-runtime teardown; then settle retired-session tasks at that teardown boundary using existing completion events.
5481.caveats: Both clean checkouts reproduce the event-state gap, not the historical desktop sequence. Current edits reject active tasks with 409. No live provider or UI was run; no automatic fix PR qualifies.
